imperative держи! when handing something over

meanings.note: Borrowed from French 'dessert' (from 'desservir', to clear the table).

examples.trans: Guests in the dining room are already asking for new desserts.
Oh, Samson. What have you come for?

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!
examples.trans: Because of your Lyolya the whole class calls me a little liar!

examples.text: Я пришёл к нашему кондитеру Луи!
examples.trans: I arrived at our pastry chef Louis's place!
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: в кухне / на кухне = in the kitchen, на кухню = to the kitchen
E.g. русская кухня. Entered Russian via Polish 'kuchnia' and Middle High German 'küchen', ultimately from Late Latin 'coquina' (from 'coquere', to cook).

examples.trans: And the kitchen is over there.
We are sitting in the kitchen.

examples.text: Проходите, пожалуйста! Как видите, большой коридор, а там кухня.
examples.trans: Come on in, please! As you can see, a big hall, and the kitchen is over there.

examples.text: Самсон, больше ему ничего не ломай.
examples.trans: Samson, don't break anything else of his.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!

examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: у + genitive = from someone: у меня научился

examples.text: А он с девочками разговаривать не научился.
examples.trans: And he never learned how to talk to girls.

examples.text: Есть такой английский повар. Я по его передачам научусь готовить.
examples.trans: There is this English chef. I will learn to cook from his shows.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I won't leave him on his own.

examples.text: Вика, ну он одинокий. Я же не оставлю его одного.
examples.trans: Vika, come on, he's all alone. I can't just leave him on his own.

examples.text: Почему ты не отвечаешь на мои вопросы?

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.

examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.
